description: When a check counts as «checked with all alarms» (Android BackgroundSchedule.kt, iOS BackgroundSchedule.swift; stored as Android RefreshStats.lastFullCheck, iOS SharedStorage.lastAlarmCheckAt – the dedupe lock of the next scheduled run and the line «last checked» read it). isFullCheck: all queryable pairs attempted and MORE than half with a price (attempted > 0, 0 <= failed < attempted, (attempted - failed) * 2 > attempted); live ticks and partial runs do not count. marksAlarmCheck: the time is set only for a full check, and if alarms with extra data wait for a later step (deferredWaiting: volume, funding/OI, high/low, converted – the iOS background task; Android evaluates every alarm kind in one step, so false there) only once they were checked too (deferredChecked); otherwise the old value stays.
